about_the_game:
VIKING – Sagas of the Norse Lands is an isometric 2D city-builder, rooted in the Viking Age and based on an old-school grid-building system, which allows you to build and govern your city.

Immerse yourself in the Nordic landscapes and relive 273 years of Viking history, from the first raid on the great monastery of Lindisfarne (793) to the Battle of Stamford Bridge (1066). Manage all aspects of Viking culture and lead your people to greatness.

Build the greatest Viking city

VIKING – Sagas of the Norse Lands takes up the basics of the gameplay of the first city-builders of the 2000s. Design and build your own city over nearly three centuries of history. A road, houses, a water well... The adventure can begin!

Harvest, transform and manage your resources

Create numerous production lines and provide your citizens with everything they need. Produce wheat on your farms, turn it into flour in a mill, and bake bread to feed your people. Use the resources for your needs or to trade with other cities!

An intuitive and accessible interface

The interface of VIKING – Sagas of the Norse Lands has been designed for immediate understanding. The side panel brings together all the essential information and gives you quick access to the buildings and management data associated with each category.

Features

VIKING – Sagas of the Norse Lands has many features:

  • AN OLD-SCHOOL ISOMETRIC GRID CONSTRUCTION SYSTEM

  • MANAGE THE NEEDS of your population (food, culture, health, safety, etc.)

  • COLLECT RESOURCES, transform them and use them for your needs or for trade.

  • MANY BUILDINGS made available (more to follow during Early Access)

  • BIG MAPS will allow you to build impressive cities

  • ESTABLISH GOVERNMENT, manage salaries and collect taxes from your citizens

  • PIXEL ART GRAPHICS with many animations worked with the greatest care!

  • AN IMMERSIVE SOUNDSCAPE thanks to the location of the environment!

  • AN ORIGINAL SOUNDTRACK of medieval/Norse music that will transport you to the Viking Age!

  • And much more!

A word from the developer

Hello!

My name is Florian and I am the developer of the game "VIKING – Sagas of the Norse Lands".

This project started 5 years ago now and I've been working on it full-time for over 2 years. I hope you enjoy it and spend many hours having fun with it.

Being alone on the project, I am counting on your many feedbacks to help me improve the game. All your feedback/comments/opinions will be read and appreciated, both positive and negative, in order to make this game as entertaining as possible.

Thank you for your interest in this game!

Florian
detailed_description:
Roadmap

During Early Access, many features will be added to the game. Some will be changed and maybe some will be deleted.

At the moment, the game does not have all its content, due to Early Access. Take into account that the game will grow over time and have a lot more content.

Now, here is the list of the different elements that are planned in the game during the Early Access phase.

[This list is non-exhaustive and is subject to change in the future]

Game modes

  • A "campaign" mode with several historical scenarios

  • A "sandbox" mode in which you can choose a map and go on an adventure

In-game features

  • The intervention of different Viking gods and goddesses. Honor them or... fear them!

  • Trade between neighbouring cities. Sell or import the resources you'll need.

  • Raids! Prepare a ship and go on a raid to earn resources, gold, and more!

  • Awareness System : Find out what your citizens and neighboring cities think!

Game translation

The various translations will be carried out first by translation software and checked to ensure that the associated context is respected, then by your participation via the "Crowdin" platform.

If you don't see your language in this list, you can still submit it in the "Translations / Languages" forum. Depending on the number of players who request it, the language will be added for translations.

If you notice a translation error, do not hesitate to report it in this forum as well.

Playtests

Many playtests will be on the program during Early Access in order to:

  • Testing new game modes

  • Testing new features

  • Check that no bugs are still present

  • Take your feedback on everything that is good, to be improved, or even to be deleted.

Your feedback will be of crucial importance for the further development of the game, so don't hesitate to participate in the playtests and give as much feedback as possible.

short_description: VIKING - Sagas of the Norse Lands is a city-builder where you forge your legend. Become a Jarl, transform a camp into a thriving city, manage your people's expansion, and build your legacy. Explore, fight, and erect monuments to etch your saga in history!
